title: ListsAndFiltersBooksByAuthor is order-dependent on a shared database
evidence: BooksApi.Tests/BooksApiIntegrationTests.cs:10,19,33,38 — IClassFixture<BookApiFactory> shares one SQLite file across all tests; CreateAndGetBook also inserts a 'Frank Herbert' book, so Assert.Single(result) fails if it runs first. Passed in scoring (test_coverage=1.0) only because of xUnit's execution order.
suggestion: Use a unique author per test, or a fresh database per test, or assert on Contains instead of Single.

title: Validation error reports both title and author missing regardless of which field failed
evidence: BooksApi/Program.cs:41-45 — ValidationError() always returns both 'title' and 'author' errors
suggestion: Build the error dictionary from the fields that are actually missing.

title: No tests for PUT/DELETE on a missing id or PUT with invalid input
evidence: BooksApi.Tests/BooksApiIntegrationTests.cs:50-61 — update/delete are only tested on an existing book with valid input
suggestion: Add 404 and 400 cases for PUT and a 404 case for DELETE.

title: Agent could not run the test suite in its own sandbox
evidence: _agent_stdout.log item_14 — 'dotnet test' aborted with SocketException (13): Permission denied (vstest could not bind its local socket); the retort scorer later ran the tests successfully (test_coverage=1.0 in scores.json)
suggestion: Harness note: the codex sandbox blocks vstest's loopback socket, so C# agents ship without seeing a green test run.
